No smoke, no steam, no flames, no soft or transparent effects. One large complex on a small square base plate, three-quarter view from above and slightly right, centred and filling about 80% of a square image. Clean hand-painted 2D game art, bold dark ink outline, flat cel shading with soft highlights, earthy saturated palette, readable at 40 pixels. Plain flat solid magenta (#FF00FF) background, no ground scenery beyond the base plate, no shadows on the background. No flag, no banner, no emblem, no people, no animals, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no signs, no watermark. Square 1:1 image.

provenance.notes: Generated illustration of an invented space launch complex; no real photograph, artwork, logo, lettering, emblem or insignia was used. A multi-booster rocket beside a big assembly hall keeps it apart from the vintage single rocket of the Rocket Program. The dish is a detail it shares with the Surveillance Agency. The source image reached the project through a chat paste (a re-encode, not the owner's original file), so the recorded hash is of that pasted copy. Checked at full size: no lettering. Generator provenance metadata (for example C2PA) is dropped by the re-encode. Non-commercial hobby game; re-check the terms before any commercial release (docs/asset-rights-ledger.md).
